effect_description_eng:
[On Play] By deleting this Digimon, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Bagra Army] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] When an effect trashes this card from digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
